verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's official CLI documents a `scrapingbee schedule` command for cron-based recurring jobs, so this is a real recurring schedule and not just one-off calls. The docs give it only one line and call it a gated advanced feature, with no detail on where jobs run, how they are managed, or which plans get it. Missing for 10: detailed scheduling docs (job management, hosted vs. local execution, workflow chaining), clarity on access gating, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: `scrapingbee schedule` | Cron-based scheduled jobs; gated advanced feature.
